reason: I always get three quotes from local firms and go with the middle one, and a Kuwait outfit with no clients or reviews wouldn't even make my shortlist. Pay-when-happy is clever, but the build isn't what worries me, it's who answers when the site breaks in a year.
objection: They're thousands of miles away with no UK office and nobody I can ring or ask about them. If something goes wrong after I've paid, I've got no one local to chase.
would_change_my_mind: A couple of real Manchester businesses I could ring who've used them, plus a written support promise with a UK phone number and a guaranteed response time.
